topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: The village whispers grow louder each day, talk of Joren, the miller, and his hidden wealth. Who could've known? All these years, cloth of finer weave than any I've seen, coins that never run dry. How many of us toiled under the sun while he kept his silken purse? I look at the soil, always the same, hard and demanding. The saints must see, but do they hear? We walk the same paths, breathe the same air, yet some seem to drink from a different cup. The earth gives what it will, but what if it's not enough? I keep thinking of the harvest, hoping for more, needing more. The wind seems colder lately, even though the leaves are still green.
